11.3 50/11 Product line — Moving Mass Reference Table (continued from previous page)

Base configuration for 50/11 product line:

| # | Model | Opening | Number of panels | PL [mm] | HL [mm] | Panel type | Fire homologation | Moving mass [Kg] |
|---|-------|---------|-----------------|---------|---------|------------|-------------------|------------------|
| 0 | 50/11 VF | Side | 2 | 800 | 2.000 | Metal sheet | F.R. E 120 | 34,49 |

Multiplier factors for 50/11 product line:

| # | Concept | Multiplier factor |
|---|---------|------------------|
| 1 | Difference from T2 to T3 | 0,13 |
| 2 | Difference from T2 to T4 | 0,36 |
| 3 | Difference from T2 to C2 | 0,00 |
| 4 | Difference from T2 to C4 | 0,36 |
| 5 | Difference from T2 to C6 | 0,13 |
| 6 | Difference from T2 to C8 | 0,36 |
| 7 | Difference of 100 mm in PL | 0,08 |
| 8 | Difference of 100 mm in HL | 0,03 |
| 9 | Difference from F.R. E 120 to F.R. EI 30 | 0,18 |
| 10 | Difference from F.R. E 120 to F.R. EI 60 | 0,18 |
| 11 | Difference from F.R. E 120 to F.R. EI 120 | 0,24 |
| 12 | Difference from Metal sheet panels to Double skin panels | 0,30 |
| 13 | Difference from Metal sheet panels to Flush big vision panels | 0,96 |
| 14 | Difference from Metal sheet panels to Full glass in skirting panels | 0,89 |
| 16 | Difference from Metal sheet panels to Wien type vision panels | 0,30 |
| 17 | Difference from Metal sheet panels to Vision panels | 0,57 |

These multiplier factors are applied to the base moving mass (34,49 Kg) to calculate the actual moving mass for non-standard configurations of the 50/11 product line.
